package handlers

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"net/http"

	httpmw "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/middleware"
	answeruc "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/usecase/answer"
	studentuc "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/usecase/student"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
	"github.com/go-playground/validator/v10"
)

type StudentPracticeTaskHandler struct {
	Validator  *validator.Validate
	Students   studentuc.StudentUseCase
	Runtime    StudentRuntimeHandler
	Progress   *answeruc.ProgressionService
	Start      answeruc.StartTaskAnswer
	Submit     answeruc.SubmitTaskAnswer
	SubmitById answeruc.FinalValidation
	Get        answeruc.GetStudentAnswer
}

func (handler StudentPracticeTaskHandler) CreateStudentPracticeTask(responseWriter http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	var payload struct {
		PracticeTaskID                string `json:"practice_task_id" validate:"required,uuid"`
		PracticeTaskSolutionVariantID string `json:"practice_task_solution_variant_id" validate:"omitempty,uuid"`
	}
	if err := decodeAndValidate(handler.Validator, request, &payload); err != nil {
		http.Error(responseWriter, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	studentID, _, ok := httpmw.UserFromContext(request.Context())
	if !ok {
		http.Error(responseWriter, "unauthorized", http.StatusUnauthorized)
		return
	}
	item, err := handler.Students.CreateStudentPracticeTask(request.Context(), studentID, payload.PracticeTaskID, payload.PracticeTaskSolutionVariantID)
	if err != nil {
		writeError(responseWriter, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(responseWriter, http.StatusCreated, item)
}

func (handler StudentPracticeTaskHandler) ListStudentPracticeTasks(responseWriter http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	studentID, _, ok := httpmw.UserFromContext(request.Context())
	if !ok {
		http.Error(responseWriter, "unauthorized", http.StatusUnauthorized)
		return
	}
	items, err := handler.Students.ListStudentPracticeTasks(request.Context(), studentID)
	if err != nil {
		writeError(responseWriter, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(responseWriter, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"items": items})
}

	}
	item, err := handler.Students.GetStudentPracticeTask(request.Context(), studentID, chi.URLParam(request, "id"))
	if err != nil {
		writeError(responseWriter, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(responseWriter, http.StatusOK, item)
}

func (handler StudentPracticeTaskHandler) GetPracticeTaskLessonAccess(responseWriter http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	studentID, scopedContext, ok := handler.studentScopedPracticeTaskContext(request)
	if !ok {
		http.Error(responseWriter, "unauthorized", http.StatusUnauthorized)
		return
	}
	if handler.Progress == nil {
		http.Error(responseWriter, "progression is not configured", http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	result, err := handler.Progress.ResolveLessonAccess(scopedContext, studentID, chi.URLParam(request, "lessonID"))
	if err != nil {
		writeRuntimeError(responseWriter, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(responseWriter, http.StatusOK, result)
}

func (handler StudentPracticeTaskHandler) GetPracticeTaskLesson(responseWriter http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	studentID, scopedContext, ok := handler.studentScopedPracticeTaskContext(request)
	if !ok {
		http.Error(responseWriter, "unauthorized", http.StatusUnauthorized)
		return
	}
	if handler.Progress == nil || handler.Progress.Lessons == nil {
		http.Error(responseWriter, "lesson provider is not configured", http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	lessonID := chi.URLParam(request, "lessonID")
	access, err := handler.Progress.ResolveLessonAccess(scopedContext, studentID, lessonID)
	if err != nil {
		writeRuntimeError(responseWriter, err)
		return
	}
	if access.Locked {
		writeLessonLocked(responseWriter, access)
		return
	}
	item, err := handler.Progress.Lessons.GetLesson(scopedContext, lessonID)
	if err != nil {
		writeRuntimeError(responseWriter, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(responseWriter, http.StatusOK, buildStudentLessonResponse(item))
}

func (handler StudentPracticeTaskHandler) GetPracticeTaskTaskAccess(responseWriter http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	studentID, scopedContext, ok := handler.studentScopedPracticeTaskContext(request)
	if !ok {
		http.Error(responseWriter, "unauthorized", http.StatusUnauthorized)
		return
	}
	if handler.Progress == nil {
		http.Error(responseWriter, "progression is not configured", http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	result, err := handler.Progress.ResolveTaskAccess(scopedContext, studentID, chi.URLParam(request, "taskID"))
	if err != nil {
		writeRuntimeError(responseWriter, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(responseWriter, http.StatusOK, result)
}

func (handler StudentPracticeTaskHandler) GetPracticeTaskTask(responseWriter http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	studentID, scopedContext, ok := handler.studentScopedPracticeTaskContext(request)
	if !ok {
		http.Error(responseWriter, "unauthorized", http.StatusUnauthorized)
		return
	}
	if handler.Progress == nil || handler.Progress.TaskProvider == nil {
		http.Error(responseWriter, "task provider is not configured", http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	taskID := chi.URLParam(request, "taskID")
	access, err := handler.Progress.ResolveTaskAccess(scopedContext, studentID, taskID)
	if err != nil {
		writeRuntimeError(responseWriter, err)
		return
	}
	if access.Locked {
		writeTaskLocked(responseWriter, access)
		return
	}
	item, err := handler.Progress.TaskProvider.GetTask(answeruc.WithTaskLookupContext(scopedContext, studentID, ""), taskID)
	if err != nil {
		writeRuntimeError(responseWriter, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(responseWriter, http.StatusOK, buildStudentTaskResponse(answeruc.NormalizeTaskMetadata(item)))
}

func (handler StudentPracticeTaskHandler) StartPracticeTaskTask(responseWriter http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	studentID, scopedContext, ok := handler.studentScopedPracticeTaskContext(request)
	if !ok {
		http.Error(responseWriter, "unauthorized", http.StatusUnauthorized)
		return
	}
	out, err := handler.Start.Handle(scopedContext, answeruc.StartTaskAnswerInput{
		StudentID: studentID,
		TaskID:    chi.URLParam(request, "taskID"),
	})
	if err != nil {
		var lockedErr *answeruc.TaskLockedError
		if errors.As(err, &lockedErr) {
			writeJSON(responseWriter, http.StatusConflict, taskLockedResponse{
				Code:             "TASK_LOCKED",
				Message:          lockedErr.Error(),
				RedirectLessonID: lockedErr.RedirectLessonID,
				RedirectTaskID:   lockedErr.RedirectTaskID,
			})
			return
		}
		writeRuntimeError(responseWriter, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(responseWriter, http.StatusOK, startTaskResponse{
		AnswerID:               out.AnswerID,
		LearningActionID:       out.LearningActionID,
		SandboxID:              out.SandboxID,
		Status:                 out.Status,
		PreviewURL:             out.PreviewURL,
		Type:                   out.Type,
		TaskKind:               out.TaskKind,
		ExecutionMode:          out.ExecutionMode,
		EvaluationMode:         out.EvaluationMode,
		UIMode:                 out.UIMode,
		SubmissionMode:         out.SubmissionMode,
		RequiresSandbox:        out.RequiresSandbox,
		ExposesPreview:         out.ExposesPreview,
		ExposesTerminal:        out.ExposesTerminal,
		SupportsLiveValidation: out.SupportsLiveValidation,
		TerminalWSURL:          out.TerminalWSURL,
	})
}

func (handler StudentPracticeTaskHandler) SubmitPracticeTaskTask(responseWriter http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	taskID := chi.URLParam(request, "taskID")
	var payload SubmitRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(request.Body).Decode(&payload); err != nil {
		http.Error(responseWriter, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	if handler.Validator != nil {
		if err := handler.Validator.Struct(payload); err != nil {
			writeValidationError(responseWriter, err)
			return
		}
	}
	studentID, scopedContext, ok := handler.studentScopedPracticeTaskContext(request)
	if !ok {
		http.Error(responseWriter, "unauthorized", http.StatusUnauthorized)
		return
	}
	item, err := handler.Submit.Handle(scopedContext, answeruc.SubmitTaskAnswerInput{
		StudentID:           studentID,
		TaskID:              taskID,
		StudentTaskAnswerID: payload.StudentTaskAnswerID,
		FilestorageID:       payload.FilestorageID,
	})
	if err != nil {
		writeRuntimeError(responseWriter, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(responseWriter, http.StatusOK, buildStudentAnswerResponse(*item, nil, nil))
}

func (handler StudentPracticeTaskHandler) SubmitPracticeTaskAnswerById(responseWriter http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	studentID, scopedContext, ok := handler.studentScopedPracticeTaskContext(request)
	if !ok {
		http.Error(responseWriter, "unauthorized", http.StatusUnauthorized)
		return
	}
	taskID := chi.URLParam(request, "taskID")
	answerID := chi.URLParam(request, "answerID")

	details, err := handler.Get.Handle(scopedContext, answerID)
	if err != nil {
		writeRuntimeError(responseWriter, err)
		return
	}
	if details.Answer.StudentID != studentID || details.Answer.TaskID != taskID {
		http.Error(responseWriter, "forbidden", http.StatusForbidden)
		return
	}

	var payload submitByIDRequest
	if request.Body != nil {
		_ = json.NewDecoder(request.Body).Decode(&payload)
	}

	if err := handler.SubmitById.Handle(scopedContext, answerID, payload.AnswerPayload); err != nil {
		writeRuntimeError(responseWriter, err)
		return
	}

	updated, err := handler.Get.Handle(scopedContext, answerID)
	if err != nil {
		writeRuntimeError(responseWriter, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(responseWriter, http.StatusOK, wikiSubmitResponse{
		AnswerID: updated.Answer.ID,
		Status:   statusToWiki(updated.Answer.Status),
		Review:   buildWikiReview(updated.Answer.Status, updated.AutoReview, requestLocale(request)),
	})
}

func (handler StudentPracticeTaskHandler) GetStudentPracticeTaskRoadmap(responseWriter http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	studentID, _, ok := httpmw.UserFromContext(request.Context())
	if !ok {
		http.Error(responseWriter, "unauthorized", http.StatusUnauthorized)
		return
	}
	item, err := handler.Students.GetRoadmapForUser(request.Context(), studentID, chi.URLParam(request, "id"))
	if err != nil {
		writeError(responseWriter, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(responseWriter, http.StatusOK, item)
}

func (handler StudentPracticeTaskHandler) Recalculate(responseWriter http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
	studentID, _, ok := httpmw.UserFromContext(request.Context())
	if !ok {
		http.Error(responseWriter, "unauthorized", http.StatusUnauthorized)
		return
	}
	item, err := handler.Students.Recalculate(request.Context(), studentID, chi.URLParam(request, "id"))
	if err != nil {
		writeError(responseWriter, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(responseWriter, http.StatusOK, item)
}

func (handler StudentPracticeTaskHandler) studentScopedPracticeTaskContext(request *http.Request) (string, context.Context, bool) {
	studentID, _, ok := httpmw.UserFromContext(request.Context())
	if !ok {
		return "", nil, false
	}
	scopedContext := answeruc.WithPracticeTaskScope(
		request.Context(),
		chi.URLParam(request, "id"),
		chi.URLParam(request, "partID"),
		chi.URLParam(request, "milestoneID"),
		chi.URLParam(request, "lessonID"),
	)
	return studentID, scopedContext, true
}
